    return subprocess.run(GIT + list(a), cwd=repo, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()


def committed_changes(repo, base):
    return sorted(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", f"{base}..HEAD").splitlines())


def all_changes(repo, base):
    names = set(git(repo, "diff", "--name-only", "--no-renames", base).splitlines())
    names |= set(git(repo, "ls-files", "--others", "--exclude-standard").splitlines())
    return sorted(names)


def owned(path, owned_paths):
    c = PurePosixPath(path).parts
    return any(c[: len(PurePosixPath(o).parts)] == PurePosixPath(o).parts for o in owned_paths)


def audit(changed, owned_paths):
    bad = [f for f in changed if not owned(f, owned_paths)]
    return {"accepted": not bad, "unauthorized": bad}"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"dg_2.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() creates two worktrees and edits one, audits committed-only and full change lists, moves a file out of app/, overwrites a shared results file and loses an update in a shared state file.","descKn":"main() ಎರಡು worktrees ರಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಸಂಪಾದಿಸಿ, commit ಮಾಡಿದ-ಮಾತ್ರ ಮತ್ತು ಪೂರ್ಣ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಪಟ್ಟಿಗಳನ್ನು ಲೆಕ್ಕಪರಿಶೋಧಿಸಿ, app/ ಯಿಂದ ಫೈಲ್ ಸರಿಸಿ, ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಫೈಲ್ ಮೇಲ್ಬರೆದು ಹಂಚಿಕೆಯ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ ಫೈಲ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನವೀಕರಣ ಕಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

        raise RuntimeError(p.stderr.strip() or p.stdout.strip())
    return p


def commit_file(repo, rel, text, msg):
    (Path(repo) / rel).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (Path(repo) / rel).write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
    git(repo, "add", "-A")
    git(repo, "commit", "-q", "-m", msg)


def merge_in_order(repo, branches):
    merged = []
    if git(repo, "status", "--porcelain").stdout.strip():
        return merged, "integration checkout is not clean"
    for b in branches:
        p = git(repo, "merge", "--no-ff", "-q", "-m", f"merge {b}", b, check=False)
        if p.returncode != 0:
            git(repo, "merge", "--abort", check=False)
            return merged, f"conflict while merging {b}; merge aborted"
        merged.append(b)
    return merged, "all merged"


def gate(scope_ok, proof_ok, review_ok, tests_ok, approval_required, approved):
    reasons = [n for n, v in (("scope", scope_ok), ("proof", proof_ok), ("review", review_ok), ("integration tests", tests_ok)) if not v]
    if approval_required and not approved:
        reasons.append("human approval missing")
    return ("PASS" if not reasons else "BLOCK"), reasons


@dataclass
class ApprovalFlag:
    action: str
    approved: bool = False


def sign(action, approver):
    return hmac.new(KEY, f"{action}|{approver}".encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()


def verify_approval(record, action):
    if record.get("action") != action:
        return False
